title: Model grant
description: ModelGrant record: a stronger model profile for one task of an executor for one or two attempts. Lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/grant.md. The whole lifecycle comes in v0.2; until then the granted slot is reserved.

kind.description: From v0.2: grant for a stronger model on request (MGR-17), takeover for a takeover task on the seat profile (MGR-21); grant when absent.

profile.description: Model profile from the role's ladder and those allowed to the tenant.

attempts_left.description: Grant attempts left; 1 or 2 at grant time.

cap_eur.description: Ceiling for the whole grant in euro cents (BUD-9).

expires_at.description: Not later than 6 h from the decision.

line.description: Budget line: grant, or takeover for a grant of kind takeover (MGR-21).

untrusted.description: The request was made in distrust mode: only the first step of the ladder.

reason.description: Reason for the denial or the end: grant_not_eligible, grant_over_budget, grant_rate_limited, grant_expired_unanswered, grant_revoked.
